thread:
Lena Cortez: quick UX catch from QA pass — retention control in the compliance modal is labeled 'Retention' and the slider shows days but the visual ticks aren't labeled. people are asking if they set 0 it's infinite or immediate deletion :grimacing:
Evan Park: ah yeah. current placeholder says '0' = off which is ambiguous. we should change label to 'Retention period (days)' and add a small helper '0 = retain forever' or '0 = indefinite' depending on legal's definition
Aisha Khan: legal prefers '0 = retain indefinitely' wording. also suggest numeric input next to slider for precise values (keyboard accessible)
Tom Brooks: +1 on numeric input. accessibility note: slider needs aria-valuetext describing both days and human-readable, e.g. aria-valuetext="Retention period: 30 days"
Lena Cortez: another thing: region selector auto-detect shows 'Primary region: US' as large label. support said customers expect the full cloud region code (us-east-1) to match their infra. can we show both? like 'United States (us-east-1)'
Evan Park: we can default to friendly name + code. for very narrow widths we'll collapse to '(us-east-1)'. add tooltip with full region display for truncated items
Aisha Khan: KMS badge copy is confusing in the modal and in the audit trail. current badge reads 'KMS: On'. propose two variants to test with users: 1) 'Key custody: Redwood' / 'Key custody: Customer (KMS)'; 2) 'Encryption: Redwood-managed' / 'Encryption: Customer-managed (KMS)'. which one is clearer?
Tom Brooks: I prefer the first set — 'Key custody' maps to legal docs. avoid words like 'managed' without owner. also make the badge readable by screen readers: role="status" and aria-label="Key custody: Customer (KMS)"
aria-bot: Accessibility alert: badge contrast measured 3.6:1 on current background. fails AA for 12px text. recommend increasing font-weight or switching text color to #053F9A to reach >=4.5:1
Evan Park: noted. will change to stronger weight and test #053F9A. also add focus-visible ring so keyboard users can tab to the badge and open details
Lena Cortez: audit log copy — regression flagged entries like 'encryption toggled' without actor or key. that's not acceptable for compliance. proposed format for UI and CSV export:
```
2026-03-05T09:44:12Z, lena.cortez@example.com, retention_period_days, 30 -> 0
2026-03-05T09:45:01Z, lena.cortez@example.com, key_custody, Redwood -> Customer (KMS: arn:aws:kms:...)
```
Include actor email, field, before->after, and key arn when applicable
Aisha Khan: keep timestamp ISO UTC like above. for the audit UI list we display newest first, but when downloading CSV we should default to oldest-first. label the download button with the ordering: 'Download audit (oldest first)'
Tom Brooks: CTA ordering in modal is awkward — primary is currently 'Save changes' but when user is in the Add customer key flow the primary should be 'Confirm key' and secondary 'Save'. propose making primary contextual by flow state
Evan Park: doable. will implement contextual primary and ensure the tab order stays consistent so keyboard doesn't jump between controls when state flips
Lena Cortez: copy tweak: change retention helper from 'learn more' to 'View retention docs' to improve discoverability in support transcripts
aria-bot: Checklist added: "slider numeric input, aria-valuetext, badge aria-label & role=status, contrast >=4.5:1, tooltip on truncated region items, audit CSV columns: timestamp, actor, field, before, after, key_arn"
Aisha Khan: I'll loop in compliance/legal on 'retain indefinitely' wording and on audit CSV fields. Tom 	7 can you mock the numeric input and new badge styles in the design file?
Tom Brooks: on it. aiming for prototype by Fri morning. will include both badge text variants for quick preference testing
Lena Cortez: great — if we can get the prototype and legal sign-off next week we can roll the UI patch in the following release. thanks everyone :rocket:
